cards.text: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD comes to the prophet Ezekiel, and he's the one telling it. It's one more message about Egypt, after a whole string of them in the chapters before (Ezekiel 29:1-32:16). And he knows the EXACT day, friend, while I have to check my phone to find out it's Thursday.
God calls him "Son of man" and gives him news about the multitudes of Egypt. Egypt is on its way out, and this is NOT good news.

cards.question: With news that heavy, what does God tell Ezekiel to do for the multitudes of Egypt?
Egypt is going down, along with the daughters of the mighty nations. Where does God tell Ezekiel to consign them?

answers.text: To the depths of the earth

cards.text: Then God asks Egypt, "Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and be placed with the uncircumcised!" Friend, that's the kind of question where you don't answer. You just stare at your shoes.

cards.question: God asks Egypt who she is more beautiful than, then sends her down to be placed with the uncircumcised. True or false: He is telling Egypt she stands above the rest.

cards.text: Egypt will fall among those slain by the sword, and God declares, "The sword is appointed!" I thought getting slid into the back of the junk drawer was rough, friend. This is a WHOLE other level.

cards.question: God says to let them drag Egypt away. True or false: her multitudes get left behind.

cards.text: From the middle of Sheol, somebody speaks up about Egypt and her allies: "They have come down and lie with the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword." I picture the whole room looking up, like when the new hire walks into the office.

cards.question: Down in Sheol, who speaks up about Egypt and her allies coming down?

cards.text: Then the message tours who's already down there, like a real estate agent showing the WORST open house ever. First up is Assyria, a mighty empire, with her whole company and her graves all around her.

cards.question: Assyria's company now lies slain in the depths of the Pit. What did they once do in the land of the living?
Next in the Pit is Elam, a nation to the east, with all her multitudes around her grave, slain by the sword. True or false: down there, Elam is honored for the terror she once spread.

cards.text: Among the slain, they prepare a resting place for Elam and all her hordes. Then Meshech and Tubal, two far-off peoples, are there too with all their multitudes and their graves all around them, and friend, this guest list keeps GROWING.

The fallen warriors of old went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, their swords placed under their heads and their shields resting on their bones. That's a FULL send-off, friend; when I went into the drawer, all I got was paper and dust on top of me.

cards.question: True or false: Meshech and Tubal lie down with the fallen warriors of old, the ones who went down to Sheol with their swords placed under their heads.
Partway through the list of nations, the message turns and speaks to "you." What will happen to "you"?

answers.text: You will be spared this time
You will rule over them all

cards.question: Edom, Israel's neighbor to the south, is there too, with all her kings and princes. True or false: their might keeps them out from among those slain by the sword.

cards.text: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians, the people of the coastal city of Sidon, are there too, gone down in disgrace with the slain. Now picture Pharaoh, Egypt's king, arriving and looking around at every one of them.

cards.question: When Pharaoh sees all these nations in the Pit, what does God say happens to him?

answers.text: He will cry out for help

cards.text: Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, and he's COMFORTED. I think that's like getting a parking ticket and feeling better because the WHOLE street got one.

cards.question: Then God has the last word, and the line about terror in the land of the living comes back one more time. Whose terror is it now?

cards.text: So Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD. Assyria, Elam, Meshech, Tubal, Edom, Sidon, Egypt: friend, that's a LONG list of big names, and NOT ONE of them gets the last word.
